tables.name: Coaches
tables.description: Canonical Coach person/profile record for the new Hub. Broad account identity lives here; recurring Session assignment and role are owned by Session Staff, dated staffing/cover by Occurrence Staff, normal rates by Coach Rate Profiles and completed costs by Coach Allocations. Fields prefixed LEGACY belong to the retired Hub and must not be used by new code.

fields.name: Coach ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub and later Supabase account mapping.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Broad Hub/account classification only. Do not use this field as the Coach's role on a Session. Session-specific roles come from Session Staff -> Coach Roles.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = current/active coach. Untick when they leave; keep the record so historical links remain intact.

fields.name: LEGACY — Players
fields.description: Retired direct Coach-to-Player relationship. Never use for Player-data permission. Access derives from Session Staff / Occurrence Staff and role permissions.

fields.name: Supabase User ID
fields.description: Future login mapping. Leave blank until Supabase is connected; then this links the Airtable coach record to the authenticated Hub user.

fields.name: LEGACY — Sessions
fields.description: Retired direct recurring-session convenience relationship from the previous Hub. New permanent assignments are owned by Session Staff.

fields.name: LEGACY — Player Session Requests
fields.description: Orphaned compatibility field left after the old Player Session Requests table was retired. Do not use in new code.

fields.name: LEGACY — Player Session Links
fields.description: Retired convenience relationship. Do not use to determine Coach access to Players. Access is role- and Session-based.

fields.name: LEGACY — Coach Role
fields.description: Retired global/profile role relationship. Session-specific role is authoritative on Session Staff; temporary role changes use Staff Role Overrides.

fields.name: LEGACY — Session Occurrences
fields.description: Retired convenience relationship from old occurrence staffing. Dated staffing is owned by Occurrence Staff.

fields.name: LEGACY — Schedule Aliases
fields.description: Old name-matching aliases used by spreadsheet-driven scheduling. Do not use in the new architecture; stable Coach ID / linked Coach records are authoritative.

fields.name: Staff Availability Requests
fields.description: Inverse link to Staff Availability Requests submitted by this Coach.

fields.name: Staff Availability Requests
fields.description: Inverse link to Staff Availability Requests where this Coach is the selected Replacement Coach.

tables.name: Coach Roles
tables.description: Reusable role-capability model for coaches. Role Key is the stable internal identifier the Hub's access logic reads - Role Name is safe to rename without changing what a role can do. Coaches links to this table via its own "Coach Role" field.

fields.name: Role Name
fields.description: SAFE TO EDIT - display wording shown in Airtable. Renaming this never changes permissions.

fields.name: Role Key
fields.description: BACKEND KEY - stable internal identifier (e.g. lead_coach). Do not derive permissions from Role Name; do not rename/reuse a key once in use.

fields.name: Can View Players
fields.description: Must be true for a coach holding this role to see any player/session data, even when scheduled or covering a session.

fields.name: LEGACY — Coaches
fields.description: Retired global/profile reverse link. Do not use to assign role permissions. Coach Roles apply through Session Staff and Staff Role Overrides.

fields.name: Can Send Communications
fields.description: Role-level permission for sending session/group/individual notices. Intended final rule: Lead Coach only.

fields.name: Can View Player Names
fields.description: Role-level permission to see names on a session. Learning Coach may see names without opening profiles.

tables.name: Players
tables.description: Canonical Player person record for the new Hub. Player identity/profile data remains here; access comes from verified Parent–Player Links, service participation from Player Session Links/Bookings, and Coach access from authorised Session Staff / Occurrence Staff. Fields prefixed LEGACY belong to the retired Hub and must not be used by new code.

fields.name: Player ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub and later Supabase links.

fields.name: LEGACY — Team / Session
fields.description: Retired free-text session field from the previous Hub. Do not use in new code. Current service relationships come from Player Session Links.

fields.name: LEGACY — Active
fields.description: Retired manual player-active flag. Do not use as the canonical activity definition in new code. Player/family activity should derive from current memberships/bookings while preserving the Player record.

fields.name: LEGACY — Assigned Coaches
fields.description: Retired direct Player-to-Coach relationship. Never use for permissions. Coach access comes from authorised Session Staff / Occurrence Staff relationships and role permissions.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Used to safely match a child entered during parent signup to the correct player record. Do not use name alone for matching.

fields.name: LEGACY — Player Session Requests
fields.description: Orphaned compatibility field left after the old Player Session Requests table was retired. Do not use in new code.

fields.name: Address Line 1
fields.description: Structured home address for the Player profile. Parent-editable normal family information.

fields.name: Address Line 2
fields.description: Optional second line of the Player home address.

fields.name: Town / City
fields.description: Town or city for the Player home address.

fields.name: County
fields.description: County/region for the Player home address.

fields.name: Postcode
fields.description: Postcode for the Player home address.

fields.name: Medical Information State
fields.description: Distinguishes incomplete medical information from an explicit confirmation that there is nothing to report.

fields.name: Medical Information
fields.description: Current relevant medical information. Normal history should record that this changed without exposing old/new sensitive values in the standard timeline.

fields.name: Additional Support State
fields.description: Distinguishes incomplete support information from an explicit confirmation that there are no additional support needs.

fields.name: Additional Support Needs
fields.description: Current additional support needs or useful support information for authorised users.

fields.name: Photo / Video Permission
fields.description: Parent-facing permission state. Keep explicit Unknown/Not set rather than treating a blank as No.

fields.name: School
fields.description: Optional current school for the Player profile.

fields.name: School Year
fields.description: Optional current school year / year group. Kept separate from Session age-group eligibility.

tables.name: Sessions
tables.description: Canonical recurring Session structure for the new Management Hub. Airtable owns operational Session setup; dated truth lives in Session Occurrences. Staffing is owned by Session Staff, venue by linked Venues, client by linked Client / Organisation, and lifecycle by Session Lifecycle Status. Fields prefixed LEGACY are retained only because field deletion is not available through the current connector and must not be used by new code.

fields.name: Session ID
fields.description: Permanent stable Session ID used by the Hub and integrations. Created/assigned in the new operational model; do not derive authority from an old Google Sheet row.

fields.name: Session Name
fields.description: Human-readable Session name managed as part of the canonical Airtable Session record.

fields.name: LEGACY — Active
fields.description: Retired compatibility field from the previous Hub. Do not use in new code. Session Lifecycle Status is the canonical lifecycle field.

fields.name: LEGACY — Permanent Coaches
fields.description: Retired staffing field from the previous Hub. Do not use in new code. Session Staff is the canonical recurring staffing relationship.

fields.name: LEGACY — Player Session Requests
fields.description: Orphaned compatibility field left after the old Player Session Requests table was retired. Do not use in new code.

fields.name: Programme
fields.description: Operational programme this session belongs to, e.g. Academy, Jets, School Coaching, TDC. Managed from the Hub.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Operational category used for grouping/filtering sessions. Keep separate from Programme so reporting can evolve without renaming the session.

fields.name: Age Group
fields.description: Human-facing age/year group for this session, e.g. U10, Years 3–4.

fields.name: Venue
fields.description: Authoritative operational venue for this session. Link to the Venues table rather than matching venue names as text.

fields.name: LEGACY — Client / School
fields.description: Old text-based client field. Do not use in new code. Use linked Client / Organisation.

fields.name: Default Day
fields.description: Normal recurring day for the session template. Dated truth belongs in Session Occurrences.

fields.name: Default Start Time
fields.description: Normal start time for recurring occurrences, stored as 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 16:30. Dated occurrence times override this.

fields.name: Default End Time
fields.description: Normal end time for recurring occurrences, stored as 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 17:30. Dated occurrence times override this.

fields.name: Default Capacity
fields.description: Normal operational capacity. Specific occurrences may override this.

fields.name: Schedule Pattern
fields.description: Describes how occurrences are normally created. Occurrences remain the dated source of truth.

fields.name: LEGACY — Source Coach Names
fields.description: Old name-based migration field. Do not use in new code. Use Session Staff with stable Coach links.

fields.name: LEGACY — Operating Periods
fields.description: Orphaned compatibility field from the retired term model. Do not use in new code. Use Start Date, End Date, Schedule Breaks and Session Occurrences.

fields.name: Delivery Area
fields.description: Top-level operational area of the business. This describes what kind of delivery the session is, not where it happens.

fields.name: Venue Relationship
fields.description: How this session uses its physical venue. Kept on the Session because one venue can be a client site for one session and a hired venue for another.

fields.name: Client / Organisation
fields.description: Operational client/organisation for this session. Separate from the physical Venue. Semantically one client per session where relevant.

fields.name: Start Date
fields.description: First date this Session is intended to run. Used with Schedule Pattern and Default Day to generate dated Session Occurrences.

fields.name: End Date
fields.description: Final date this Session is intended to run. Used with Schedule Pattern and Default Day to generate dated Session Occurrences.

fields.name: Commercial Model
fields.description: How this Session is commercially funded. Controls whether parent booking/payment flows are available.

fields.name: Booking Access
fields.description: Parent access rule for joining/bookings. Independent from the price model.

fields.name: Billing Model
fields.description: Operational billing method only. Actual prices, rates, costs and revenue remain in Google Sheets as the financial source of truth.

fields.name: Finance Key
fields.description: Stable reference used by the Hub/backend to match this Session to its financial/commercial record in Google Sheets without duplicating prices in Airtable.

fields.name: Session Lifecycle Status
fields.description: Canonical Session lifecycle for the new Management Hub. Draft = Management-only and must not generate live occurrences; Active = live/operating; Inactive = retained for history but no longer active.

fields.name: LEGACY — Effective Lifecycle Status
fields.description: Temporary migration formula from the old Active flag. Do not use for new wiring once Session Lifecycle Status is the sole canonical lifecycle field.

tables.name: Player Session Links
tables.description: Canonical Player-to-Session membership/service relationship for the new Hub. Membership Lifecycle Status and the additive pause/cancellation/end fields are authoritative for future code. Fields prefixed LEGACY belong to the retired Hub and must not be used when the new Hub is wired. Ended memberships are preserved for history.

fields.name: Link ID
fields.description: Stable Hub relationship ID. Do not reuse.

fields.name: LEGACY — Status
fields.description: Retired membership-state field from the previous Hub. Do not use in new code. Membership Lifecycle Status is canonical.

fields.name: LEGACY — End Date
fields.description: Old membership end-date field tied to the previous 28-day access logic. Do not use in new code. Use Scheduled End Date plus the final lifecycle/access rules.

fields.name: LEGACY — Coaches At End
fields.description: Old former-access snapshot based on Permanent Coaches. Do not use in new code. Future former-player access is derived from authorised Session Staff/role history under the final 21-day rule.

fields.name: Membership Lifecycle Status
fields.description: Canonical membership lifecycle for the new Hub, including Active, Paused, Cancellation Pending, Ending Scheduled and Ended. Fields prefixed LEGACY must not be used by new code.

fields.name: Pause Start Date
fields.description: First date the membership is paused. Paused keeps the place but removes the Player from future live attendance and pauses billing once wired.

fields.name: Pause Return Date
fields.description: Optional planned return date. Leave blank when return is Management-controlled.

fields.name: Pause Reason
fields.description: Operational reason/context for the pause.

fields.name: Cancellation Requested Date
fields.description: Date a Parent requested subscription/membership cancellation. Notice timing is calculated from this request, not from later review.

fields.name: Notice Start Date
fields.description: Date the cancellation notice period started.

fields.name: Scheduled End Date
fields.description: Future effective end date once cancellation/end has been approved or scheduled.

fields.name: Membership End Reason
fields.description: Reason/context for ending the membership. Historical membership records are retained, not deleted.

fields.name: Booked By Parent
fields.description: Parent/Guardian who originally made the booking or membership request. Kept separate from the person who later pays.

fields.name: Billing Rule
fields.description: Commercial rule that applied to this membership. Current/future rule changes must not rewrite historical membership understanding.

fields.name: Commercial Model Snapshot
fields.description: Historical snapshot of the Session commercial model when this membership was created/confirmed.

fields.name: Billing Model Snapshot
fields.description: Historical snapshot of the billing model used for this membership.

fields.name: Price Snapshot
fields.description: Historical service price associated with this membership at creation/confirmation. Payment transactions themselves remain outside this table.

tables.name: Parents & Guardians
tables.description: One record per parent or guardian with Hub access. Supabase handles login/security; this table stores the operational parent identity used to link them to players.

fields.name: Parent ID
fields.description: Stable Hub ID. Do not reuse or change once linked.

fields.name: Supabase User ID
fields.description: Links this Airtable parent/guardian to the authenticated Supabase user.

tables.name: Parent–Player Links
tables.description: Canonical Parent/Guardian-to-Player relationship and access record. Link Lifecycle Status controls the relationship lifecycle; verified relationship logic is the child-access authority. Contact Priority affects communication order only. Fields prefixed LEGACY belong to the retired Hub and must not be used in new code.

fields.name: Link ID
fields.description: Stable Hub relationship ID. Do not reuse.

fields.name: LEGACY — Link Status
fields.description: Retired relationship-state field from the previous Parent Hub. Do not use in new code. Link Lifecycle Status is canonical.

fields.name: LEGACY — Primary Contact
fields.description: Retired contact-order checkbox. Do not use in new code. Contact Priority is canonical and does not change Player-data permissions.

fields.name: Contact Priority
fields.description: Communication priority only. Both verified Parents retain equal child-data access; this does not grant extra permission.

fields.name: Verification Method
fields.description: How this Parent–Player relationship was verified.

fields.name: Verified At
fields.description: When this relationship became Verified.

fields.name: Verified By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of the management/user actor responsible where verification involved a user action.

fields.name: Verified By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Readable historical name of the person responsible for verification where applicable.

fields.name: Invite Status
fields.description: State of a second-Parent/Guardian invitation. Pending invitation gives zero Player access.

fields.name: Invite Sent At
fields.description: When the latest invitation was sent.

fields.name: Invite Accepted At
fields.description: When the invited Parent/Guardian completed verification and access was accepted.

fields.name: Ended At
fields.description: When this verified Parent–Player access relationship ended. Ending a link stops access but preserves history.

fields.name: Ended By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of the management user who ended the relationship where applicable.

fields.name: Ended By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Readable historical name of the management user who ended the relationship.

fields.name: End Reason
fields.description: Required reason/context when a verified Parent–Player relationship is ended.

fields.name: Link Lifecycle Status
fields.description: Canonical Parent–Player relationship lifecycle for the new Hub. Future access checks should use this lifecycle together with verification state; fields prefixed LEGACY must not be used.

fields.name: Family
fields.description: Family/household context for this specific Parent–Player relationship. This does not grant Player access; verification state on the Parent–Player Link remains authoritative.

tables.name: Session Occurrences
tables.description: One record per real dated session. This is the dated source of truth for schedules, covers, cancellations, completed sessions and future attendance/history. The parent Session is the template; this table records what is scheduled and what actually happened.

fields.name: Occurrence Name
fields.description: Human-readable label, e.g. Feltonfleet Football Club — 24 Sep 2026.

fields.name: Occurrence ID
fields.description: Permanent unique ID used by the Hub and finance joins. Never reuse or change once linked.

fields.name: Session
fields.description: Parent Session template. Semantically one parent Session per occurrence.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: Calendar date this session is scheduled to happen or happened.

fields.name: Start Date & Time
fields.description: Actual scheduled start for this occurrence.

fields.name: End Date & Time
fields.description: Actual scheduled end for this occurrence.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Dated operational status. Completed preserves historical truth; cancelled occurrences stay in history rather than being deleted.

fields.name: LEGACY — Assigned Coaches
fields.description: Old occurrence staffing convenience field. Do not use in new code. Occurrence Staff is canonical for dated staffing and cover.

fields.name: Venue
fields.description: Venue for this specific date. Normally copied from the Session when occurrences are created, but can differ for a one-off change.

fields.name: Capacity Override
fields.description: Optional date-specific capacity. Leave blank to use the parent Session Default Capacity.

fields.name: Operational Notes
fields.description: Date-specific operational notes for management/coaches.

fields.name: Finance Reference
fields.description: Optional external finance/booking reference. Occurrence ID should normally be the primary join key; use this only when the financial source has its own immutable reference.

fields.name: Created
fields.description: When this occurrence record was created.

fields.name: Last Updated
fields.description: Most recent change to this occurrence record.

fields.name: LEGACY — Source Assigned Coach Names
fields.description: Old name-based migration field. Do not use in new code. Use Occurrence Staff / Coach Allocations.

fields.name: Confirmation State
fields.description: Separate from delivery Status. Tracks whether management has confirmed what actually happened on this occurrence.

fields.name: Confirmed At
fields.description: When management confirmed the occurrence.

fields.name: Confirmed By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of management user who confirmed the occurrence.

fields.name: Confirmed By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Readable historical name of the person who confirmed the occurrence.

fields.name: Exception At
fields.description: When cancellation/postponement/reschedule/partial-delivery exception was recorded. Used by cancellation-pay rules.

fields.name: Exception Reason
fields.description: Reason an occurrence did not proceed normally.

fields.name: Replacement Occurrence
fields.description: Replacement dated occurrence when a session is rescheduled.

fields.name: Schedule Change State
fields.description: Semantic schedule exception state. Blank/Standard = normal occurrence; Changed = same occurrence with a confirmed date/time/venue-type change; Rescheduled = occurrence is part of a reschedule relationship. Lifecycle Status remains separate.

fields.name: Display Status
fields.description: Convenience status for Hub display. Keeps lifecycle Status and schedule-change state separate underneath.

fields.name: Register State
fields.description: Player register status for this exact occurrence. Used by Needs Attention register-incomplete logic.

tables.name: Session Staff
tables.description: Permanent/regular coach assignments to recurring Sessions. Long-term staffing authority once the Hub is migrated. Existing Permanent Coaches fields remain untouched for rollback.

fields.name: Session Staff ID
fields.description: Stable unique ID written by the secure backend, e.g. SS-0001.

fields.name: Session
fields.description: Recurring Session this assignment belongs to.

fields.name: Coach
fields.description: Coach assigned to the Session.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Authoritative session-specific role for this permanent Session Staff assignment. Role permissions come from Coach Roles.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Whether this regular assignment is currently active.

fields.name: Effective From
fields.description: Optional date this regular assignment starts.

fields.name: Effective Until
fields.description: Optional planned end date. Blank means no planned end.

fields.name: Inactive At
fields.description: Timestamp management made this assignment inactive. Starts former-access window.

fields.name: Former Access Until
fields.description: 21-day former-access expiry, written by the secure backend when assignment becomes inactive.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Optional internal management notes.

tables.name: Occurrence Staff
tables.description: Planned and actual staffing for each dated Session Occurrence. Preserves who was expected, who was absent, who covered, and the role actually worked.

fields.name: Occurrence Staff ID
fields.description: Stable unique ID written by the secure backend.

fields.name: Session Occurrence
fields.description: Dated session this staffing record belongs to.

fields.name: Coach
fields.description: Coach involved in this dated session.

fields.name: Session Staff Source
fields.description: Optional source permanent Session Staff record. Occurrence Staff is the dated reality and may also represent cover, additional or temporary-role staffing.

fields.name: Planned Role Snapshot
fields.description: Role expected for this date, stored as text so history does not change if role names later change.

fields.name: Actual Role Snapshot
fields.description: Role actually worked on the day, stored as text snapshot.

fields.name: Assignment Type
fields.description: Why this coach is on this dated session.

fields.name: Attendance
fields.description: Simple attendance state for staffing confirmation.

fields.name: Management Confirmed
fields.description: Whether management has confirmed this staffing record as part of the actual delivery.

fields.name: Confirmed At
fields.description: When this staffing record was confirmed.

fields.name: Confirmed By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of the management user who confirmed the staffing record.

fields.name: Confirmed By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Name snapshot of the confirming management user for readable history.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Optional operational note.

fields.name: Covering
fields.description: Occurrence Staff row/person being replaced by this cover coach.

tables.name: Staff Role Overrides
tables.description: Temporary one-off or date-range role changes. Keeps permanent Session Staff history intact and makes exceptional dates explicit.

fields.name: Override ID
fields.description: Stable unique ID written by the secure backend.

fields.name: Session Staff
fields.description: Regular staffing assignment being temporarily overridden.

fields.name: Coach
fields.description: Coach whose session role is being changed temporarily.

fields.name: Session
fields.description: Recurring Session affected by the override.

fields.name: Override Role
fields.description: Temporary role to apply.

fields.name: Override Type
fields.description: Whether this applies to one dated session or a temporary date range.

fields.name: Session Occurrence
fields.description: Specific dated session for a one-off override.

fields.name: Effective From
fields.description: Start of date-range override.

fields.name: Effective Until
fields.description: End of date-range override. Normal role resumes after this date.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Optional reason for the temporary role change.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Whether the override is active/relevant.

tables.name: Feedback
tables.description: One record per feedback/review. Multiple records can link to the same player to preserve full history.

fields.name: Feedback Title
fields.description: Human-readable label, e.g. Archie - 26 Sep 2026.

fields.name: Feedback ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub.

fields.name: Coach User ID
fields.description: Later links the feedback author to their Supabase account.

fields.name: Published
fields.description: Tick only when this feedback is ready for the player/parent to see in the Hub.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = keep this feedback available. Untick to hide/archive it without deleting the history.

fields.name: Player
fields.description: Links each feedback record to the player it belongs to. This preserves full feedback history.

fields.name: Coach
fields.description: Links feedback to the coach who created it.

fields.name: Session
fields.description: Session context under which this feedback was created. Backend must verify coach access for this player/session.

tables.name: Feedback Ratings
tables.description: One structured rating per Feedback × Development Framework item. This keeps the framework flexible and preserves historical meaning through snapshot fields.

fields.name: Label Snapshot
fields.description: Visible framework label at the time this rating was saved.

fields.name: Group Snapshot
fields.description: Framework group at the time this rating was saved.

tables.name: Development Framework
tables.description: Configurable player-development framework used by Coach feedback and Parent/Player views. Labels/order/visibility are data-driven so future Management can edit them without code changes.

fields.name: Framework ID
fields.description: Stable internal key; do not change when renaming the visible label.

fields.name: Written Feedback Enabled
fields.description: Allows written feedback for this framework item when Per-Area Written Feedback is enabled.

fields.name: Written Prompt
fields.description: Optional coach-facing prompt/guidance for written feedback on this framework item.

tables.name: Development Framework Settings
tables.description: Display/configuration settings for the development framework. Intended to be editable from Management later.

fields.name: Feedback Mode
fields.description: Controls whether this organisation/framework uses ratings, written feedback, or both. Intended for Management Hub editing.

fields.name: Show Keep Doing
fields.description: Show the Keep Doing written section on coach entry and published feedback.

fields.name: Show My Focus
fields.description: Show the My Focus written section on coach entry and published feedback.

fields.name: Show General Coach Feedback
fields.description: Show the General Coach Feedback written section on coach entry and published feedback.

fields.name: Per-Area Written Feedback
fields.description: When enabled, coaches can add written feedback against each active framework area. Stored in Feedback Ratings → Notes.

tables.name: Hub Settings
tables.description: Configurable labels and simple organisation-level settings used by the Hub so wording can change without editing app code.

fields.name: Setting
fields.description: BACKEND KEY — do not rename casually. The Hub uses this to know which label to load.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: SAFE TO EDIT — this is the wording users will see in the Hub.

tables.name: Organisation & Branding
tables.description: One record for this organisation. Controls the Hub's name, branding and basic organisation details. Keep this simple: edit the visible values, not the stable Organisation ID.

fields.name: Organisation ID
fields.description: BACKEND ID — do not change once connected. This identifies the organisation to the Hub.

fields.name: Hub Name
fields.description: SAFE TO EDIT — the Hub name users will see.

fields.name: Logo
fields.description: Upload the organisation logo here.

fields.name: Custom Primary Colour (hex)
fields.description: Only needed for an exact colour Primary Colour Preset can't match. If set, this wins over the preset. Leave blank and just use the preset instead - much easier.

fields.name: Custom Secondary Colour (hex)
fields.description: Only needed for an exact colour Secondary Colour Preset can't match. If set, this wins over the preset.

fields.name: Custom Accent Colour (hex)
fields.description: Only needed for an exact colour Accent Colour Preset can't match. If set, this wins over the preset.

fields.name: Hub Domain
fields.description: Future Hub address/domain, e.g. hub.example.com.

fields.name: Timezone
fields.description: Backend timezone, e.g. Europe/London.

fields.name: Primary Colour Preset
fields.description: The Hub's main colour (top bar, headings, hero backgrounds, nav) - pick from the list. Only use Custom Primary Colour (hex) if you need an exact shade this doesn't have.

fields.name: Secondary Colour Preset
fields.description: The Hub's secondary highlight colour - pick from the list.

fields.name: Accent Colour Preset
fields.description: The colour used for buttons and links - pick from the list.

fields.name: LEGACY — Sessions Last Synced
fields.description: Old Google-Schedule sync timestamp. Do not use in the new architecture because Airtable becomes the operational schedule source.

tables.name: Feature Controls
tables.description: Simple ON/OFF switches for Hub features. Useful later when different organisations use different parts of the same product.

fields.name: Feature Key
fields.description: BACKEND KEY — do not rename casually. The Hub uses this to identify the feature.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.description: SAFE TO EDIT — tick to enable this feature; untick to disable/hide it.

tables.name: Venues
tables.description: Canonical Venue records for the new Management Hub. Airtable owns operational venue information, venue availability/unavailability and links to Sessions/Session Occurrences. Google Sheets may consume venue costs for finance reporting but is not the operational venue source.

fields.name: Venue ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub, e.g. VEN-FREEMENS.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = this venue can appear in the Hub. Untick to hide it without deleting the record.

fields.name: Sort Order
fields.description: Controls the display order. Lower numbers appear first. Example: 1, 2, 3.

tables.name: Resources
tables.description: Resources shown in the Hub. Add or update records here without changing app code.

fields.name: Resource ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub.

fields.name: Audience
fields.description: Choose which Hub audiences should be allowed to see this resource.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = show this resource in the Hub. Untick to hide it without deleting it.

fields.name: Sort Order
fields.description: Controls display order. Lower numbers appear first.

tables.name: Coach Support
tables.description: Coach handbook/support content. Designed to be easy to edit and reorder in Airtable.

fields.name: Support ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = show this support item in the Hub. Untick to hide it without deleting it.

fields.name: Sort Order
fields.description: Controls display order. Lower numbers appear first.

tables.name: Public Pages
tables.description: Content for the public Hub landing page - shown to visitors before they sign up or sign in. No login required to see this. Add or update records here without changing app code.

fields.name: Page ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub, e.g. PUB-TRIALS-JETS.

fields.name: CTA Label
fields.description: Text for an optional button on this card, e.g. 'Find out more'.

fields.name: CTA Link
fields.description: Where the button goes. Leave blank for no button.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = show this on the public page. Untick to hide it without deleting it.

fields.name: Sort Order
fields.description: Controls display order. Lower numbers appear first.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description: Short one-line teaser shown on the grid tile, e.g. 'Information, dates and registration'. Body (below) is the fuller text shown once someone taps through.

fields.name: Custom Colour (hex)
fields.description: Only needed for an exact colour the presets below can't match (e.g. pure white/black, or a precise brand hex). If set, this wins over Colour Preset. Leave blank and just use Colour Preset instead - much easier day to day.

fields.name: Age Groups
fields.description: Comma-separated list shown as a dropdown on this card's Register Interest form, e.g. 'U7, U8, U9/10, U11/12, U13/14'. Leave blank and the form just asks for age as free text instead.

fields.name: Colour Preset
fields.description: Pick this card's background colour from the list - the easy way to set it. Only use Custom Colour (hex) instead if you need an exact shade this list doesn't have.

fields.name: Show Register Form
fields.description: On by default. Untick for a card that's just information (e.g. Upcoming Events) with no register-interest form on its page.

fields.name: Show What We Offer
fields.description: Tick to show the shared 'What We Offer' section (from the What We Offer table) underneath this page's content. Normally only ticked on the Welcome/About page.

tables.name: What We Offer
tables.description: Public-facing informational programme cards. Content is useful; manual pricing fields are presentation-only for now and should eventually be fed automatically from the relevant commercial/billing source rather than maintained separately.

fields.name: Offering ID
fields.description: Stable ID used by the Hub, e.g. OFFER-JETS.

fields.name: Image
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank and the card just shows without a photo.

fields.name: Age / Who For
fields.description: Free text shown on the card if set, e.g. 'U6–U7'. Leave blank to hide this row.

fields.name: Day / Time
fields.description: Free text shown on the card if set, e.g. 'Tuesday evenings'. Leave blank to hide this row.

fields.name: Venue
fields.description: Free text shown on the card if set, e.g. 'Meadowbank'. Leave blank to hide this row.

fields.name: Price
fields.description: Manual public display price for the current website/card only. Future aim: derive automatically from the relevant Billing Rule/payment product so pricing is not duplicated.

fields.name: Billing Period
fields.description: Manual public billing-period label for now. Future aim: derive from the relevant Billing Rule/payment product.

fields.name: Price Note
fields.description: Manual public-facing price note. Keep only for wording that cannot be derived automatically.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Tick = show this offering in the Hub. Untick to hide it without deleting it.

fields.name: Sort Order
fields.description: Controls display order. Lower numbers appear first.

tables.name: Trial Interest
tables.description: Leads captured from the public Hub's "Register Interest" forms. No login required to submit - written server-side by a dedicated Edge Function, never directly from the browser.

fields.name: Interested In
fields.description: The Public Pages card they registered interest from, e.g. 'Jets Trials'.

fields.name: Source Page ID
fields.description: Stable Page ID of the Public Pages card this came from, e.g. PUB-TRIALS-JETS.

fields.name: Age Group
fields.description: Which age group they registered interest for.

tables.name: Player & Parent Requests
tables.description: Canonical shared request/workflow record for Players & Parents. One underlying request can surface in Parent, Player, Session and Needs Attention contexts without duplication. This replaces the retired Player Session Requests workflow.

fields.name: Request ID
fields.description: Permanent stable request ID. Do not reuse.

fields.name: Request Type
fields.description: What the request is trying to change or achieve.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Shared request status used across Players & Parents workflows.

fields.name: Workflow Stage
fields.description: Optional special workflow state only when a request genuinely needs one.

fields.name: Family
fields.description: Family context for this request where relevant.

fields.name: Parent / Guardian
fields.description: Parent/Guardian directly involved in this request where relevant.

fields.name: Player
fields.description: Player directly involved in this request where relevant.

fields.name: Parent–Player Link
fields.description: Specific access relationship affected by the request where relevant.

fields.name: Session
fields.description: Session context for move/trial/offer or similar requests where relevant.

fields.name: Session Occurrence
fields.description: Exact dated occurrence where the request is occurrence-specific.

fields.name: Booking
fields.description: Booking affected by the request where relevant.

fields.name: Booking Line
fields.description: Specific Player/date booking line affected where relevant.

fields.name: Player Session Link
fields.description: Membership affected by cancellation/move or similar request where relevant.

fields.name: Requested By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of the person who submitted the request where available.

fields.name: Requested By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Readable historical name of the requester.

fields.name: Requested At
fields.description: When the request was submitted.

fields.name: Reason / Details
fields.description: Parent/Management explanation of what is being requested.

fields.name: Effective Date
fields.description: Optional intended effective date for the resulting change.

fields.name: Decision / Resolution Note
fields.description: Management-facing resolution or decision note.

fields.name: Resolved By User ID
fields.description: Supabase user ID of the Management user who resolved the request.

fields.name: Resolved By Name Snapshot
fields.description: Readable historical name of the person who resolved the request.

fields.name: Resolved At
fields.description: When the request reached its final resolved state.
